summary_md: **Charlie ([@clhdev](https://x.com/clhdev/status/2115514110414553456))** relays **Compaction Laundering** (Pixee): forged user approvals survived compaction in 87-100% of runs across five role-flattening coding agents, versus 0% for four role-typed agents. He reads it as a poisoned-memory result and recommends keeping roles typed.
relevance: A concrete compaction-time vulnerability with a clear harness-design fix.
